tier1: Original bounded three-input VAR.S full-bank calls, including matched controls and current failures

scope: All148 three-input VAR.S decoded full-bank calls with numeric expected outcomes and bounded numeric inputs, in original trace order. Includes76 matched controls and72 current failures. No selection by error or residual.

grammar.mean: Every full binary addition tree and input permutation; every site independently has one of five arithmetic/store models; divide by3 with every model. One common mean per evaluation.
grammar.squares: Every subtraction and square independently has every model; every sum tree/permutation of the squared leaves has every model.
grammar.corrected: Also every sum tree/permutation of residuals, square/divide correction, subtraction and final variance divide, each with arbitrary five-model sites. Correlations between the two sums are deliberately dropped, giving a conservative superset.
grammar.publication: RN53, with exact open/closed ties; zero signs do not affect squares or positive-integer divisors.

proof: Search subset closures are recomputed by an independent explicit permutation/two-tree enumerator with separate rational rounding code. Every intermediate set and root is verified. No expected output produces an intermediate.
limits: Three inputs and the declared two-pass/corrected identities only
Corrected reachability is conservative, not a consistent program
No coefficient, selector, threshold or method switch
No product change or Excel kernel identified
